outsiders.text:
15 edits. One face. Zero mercy.

We fed the same photo to 5 AI image editors and made each one re-edit its OWN last result 15 times: new shirt, new hair, new background, glasses off and on, add a person, remove him. The clock goes up 1 minute every step.

Who kept Lara looking https://t.co/vm11lU4I1z
outsiders.original_en:
15 edits. One face. Zero mercy.

We fed the same photo to 5 AI image editors and made each one re-edit its OWN last result 15 times: new shirt, new hair, new background, glasses off and on, add a person, remove him. The clock goes up 1 minute every step.

Who kept Lara looking https://t.co/vm11lU4I1z
outsiders.hook: Five AI image editors, one face, 15 chained re-edits each, with a running clock: a consistency torture test.
outsiders.video_tip: Run your own chained-edit test on one character (outfit, hair, background) across 2-3 models; show the drift side by side with a step counter.
outsiders.draft_en:
One face, 5 AI image editors, 15 rounds of chained edits each.

Every tool had to rework its own previous output: swap the shirt, change the hair, replace the background, take the glasses off and put them back, add a second person, then erase him. A clock ticks forward 1 minute per step.

The real test is which one still keeps Lara looking like Lara.

x_keywords.method: Read-only x MCP search_posts_all, 2 calls per keyword: last 24 h and previous 24 h (24-48 h ago); lang:en, no retweets/replies, sort=relevancy, up to 25 posts per window. This is a SAMPLE of top-relevance posts, not every post on X. Views = impression_count at fetch time. Rank = sum of sampled 24 h views; 48 h = both windows; trend = 24 h sum / previous 24 h sum (up >=1.3, down <=0.7). Fresh posts are still gaining views, so 'up' is understated. Top-post share > 70% means one viral post carries the keyword.
